name: login-copy-code
description: Verify /login openai launches the OAuth device-code view (which exposes the 'c: copy code' shortcut) and exits cleanly on Esc. Selects the 'openai' subcommand via the command menu (type /login as one literal block, Down to highlight openai, Enter) to avoid the harness char-by-char typing race. The 'c' copy behavior + on-screen 'copied to clipboard' feedback are unit-tested in tests/unit/test_login_altview_copy.py (they need a live OAuth code the tmux harness cannot mint offline); the header/prerequisite block asserted here renders on the view's first frame in every stage, so this stays network-independent.

steps.title: launch login openai view via command menu

steps.description: command executed as a slash command, not sent to the LLM
no stale altview status after exit
